scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run typecheck
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web && npm run typecheck -w cli && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json --noEmit
